text: What if all steel turned magnetic for five seconds? Bad news. Your car just picked a fight.
Every car slams into the next one. Bang. Bang. One giant metal ball.
Your key ring rips out of your pocket. Coins fly. Clang. Straight onto the fridge.
Every shopping cart snaps together. One giant metal snake. Rolling at the cars.
Your belt buckle drags you toward the train. Grab the railing? It's steel, genius.
Two cranes collide. Every steel bridge groans.
Magnets off. Everything drops. At once.
Somewhere in Germany, a guy is holding up his pants. His belt left for Munich. Alive. Humiliated.
What should go crazy next? Say it in the comments, or I pick something worse.
